subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should the gateway mutation boundary remain closed for `channels.feishu.streaming`?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but fixing it changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so maintainer intent is needed before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and keep `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only adjust progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and reduce scary command status text, which is smaller but still leaves no way to keep streaming while hiding tool-progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and keep `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu streaming-card config and reply-dispatcher behavior that this decision would extend.
